case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

You wrote that the labour and steel costs behind your offer are what your foundry has to carry, and that you value the long relationship between our two family companies. We take that seriously, and we have answered it with three concrete options rather than a simple counter-price.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a clear price from the new valid date and the simplest payment term, so your office manager can plan around it without any further calculation.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We remember that your foundry kept supplying us at the old price in a difficult year, and we want a lasting solution that is fair to both family firms.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We deeply value our long-standing partnership and the mutual support our family firms have shown each other over the years. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €142.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days. Delaying the effective date to April 2027 would require a much higher unit price to account for the extended period at the current rate. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

To offer you the most favorable unit price, we propose maintaining the 1 November 2026 effective date and have reduced our offer to €136.20. As an alternative at our standard terms, we can offer a price of €136.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your recognition of our past support for Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Over the years, our partnership has always been built on mutual trust and high-quality craftsmanship.

Extending payment terms to 45 days adds to our financing burden, so we must maintain our standard 30-day terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

For our main Angebot, we can present a price of €142.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Alternatively, for the April 2027 effective date with 30 days net, we are prepared to lower our price to €141.50 per unit. This option gives a price of €141.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
